notes.title: A new level due to the announcement of a new game
notes.notes:
With the announcement of a new game, I decided to add a level of the same theme.

This time our heroes go into space.


I need your help! Soon I will post a demo prototype of a new game, and I need the opinions of the players.

Follow the news of the demo at:
Itch: https://soloq.itch.io/remains

And add to your wishlist when the page is ready:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1309820/Remains

notes.title: Error correction
notes.notes:
This update mainly affected multiplayer.

Fixed:
[list]
[*] Spine, characters no longer look at the sky
[*] The limit of damage at home, now you can not go beyond 100%
[*] Shadow from objects in hands
[*] Now you are not stuck on the second floor
[*] Spitting now does not disappear with a large amount
[*] Fixed desync of house damage
[*] Now you can get the achievement "Friend"
[*] Sound fixed
[*] Man now does not do damage to himself
[*] Dog hitbox fixed
[/list]
Added:
[list]
[*]Waiting for players screen
[*] Management appeared in the pause menu
[/list]
